title: Navy Secretary Kimball and Admiral Radford's planes circled by an object

tellings.quote: was Kimble's plane and Radford's plane were both accosted by an object that circled around their aircraft.

plain: In 1950, on a flight from California to Hawaii, the planes carrying Navy Secretary Dan Kimball and Admiral Arthur Radford were both "accosted by an object that circled around their aircraft." Richard Dolan, a historian of UFOs, tells Michels this as something he heard from a man named Donald Kho. If true, it would mean two of the Navy's top men had a close encounter of their own.
